content: अधर {%a.%} [न ध्रियते; धृ-अच्, <sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Lower (<ab>opp.</ab> उत्तर), (<ab>lit.</ab> not held up); tending downwards; under, nether, downwards; ˚वासः under garment; असितमधरवासो बिभ्रतः <ls>Ki. 4. 38</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> अम्बर; सुवर्णसूत्राकलिताधराम्बराम् <ls>Śi. 1. 6</ls>; ˚ओष्ठ lower or nether lip, see below. (In this sense अधर partakes of the character of a pronoun). .²2 Low, mean, vile; ˚उत्तरम् See below; lower in quality, inferior. .²3 Silenced, worsted, not able to speak; see हीन, हीनवादिन्. .²4 Previous, preceding as in अधरेद्युः, <ab>q. v.</ab> .{@-रः@} The nether (or sometimes the upper) lip; in general ˚पत्रम्. प्रवेपमानाधरपत्रशोभिना <ls>Ku. 5. 27</ls> leaf-like lower lip; बिम्बाधरालक्तकः <ls>M. 3. 5</ls>; पक्वबिम्बाधरोष्ठी <ls>Me. 84</ls>; पिबसि रतिसर्वस्वमधरम् <ls>Ś. 1. 21</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">1. 23</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">3. 23</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> अधरं खलु बिम्बनामकं फलमाभ्यामिति भव्यमन्वयम् . लभतेऽधरबिम्ब इत्यदः पदमस्या रदनच्छदे वदत् .. <ls>N. 2. 24</ls>. .{@-रा@} The nadir; (अधोदिश्) or the southern direction. .{@-रम्@} .²1 The lower part (of the body); पृष्टवंशाधरे त्रिकम् <ls>Ak.</ls> .²2 Pudendum Muliebre (also {%m.%}). .²3 Address, speech (<ab>opp.</ab> उत्तर); statement, sometimes used for reply also.
